name: aave-markets-data
description: Fetch Aave market data using TypeScript SDK

scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high >/tmp/_audit1 2>/dev/null; head -1 /tmp/_audit1 | grep -qE '^found|^# npm audit report' || { cat /tmp/_audit1 >&2; exit 1; }; grep -oE 'GHSA-[a-z0-9-]+' /tmp/_audit1 | sort -u | grep -vE 'GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84|GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx' | grep -q . && exit 1; npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate >/tmp/_audit2 2>/dev/null; head -1 /tmp/_audit2 | grep -qE '^found|^# npm audit report' || { cat /tmp/_audit2 >&2; exit 1; }; grep -oE 'GHSA-[a-z0-9-]+' /tmp/_audit2 | sort -u | grep -vE 'GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84|GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx' | grep -q . && exit 1; exit 0
scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run build && npm run prune && npm run build -w aave-dashboard-backend && npm run prune -w aave-dashboard-backend && npm run test -w @internal/aave-shared-contracts && npm run test:typecheck -w aave-dashboard-backend && npm run test -w aave-dashboard-backend
scripts.ci:remote: npm run ci && npm run check:bin-paths && npm run check:workspace-coverage && npm run check:no-globstar && npm run audit
scripts.prune: ts-prune -i '\.d\.ts' 2>&1 | grep -v '(used in module)' | grep -v '^src/' | (grep -q . && exit 1 || exit 0)
